```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
source("functions.R")
window <- 20
```

## Load the data
Prices come from Yahoo Finance for the symbols in portfolio.txt, covering the last year.

```{r load}
stocks <- load_stock_data("portfolio.txt")
names(stocks)
```

## Latest prices
The last five rows for each stock.

```{r show, results='asis'}
show_data(stocks, n = 5)
```

## Statistics
Mean, median, mode, standard deviation and the latest 20 day moving average of the closing price. The mode uses prices rounded to the nearest dollar.

```{r stats}
stats_table <- all_statistics(stocks, window)
knitr::kable(stats_table, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Charts
Closing price with the 20 day moving average.

```{r charts, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
for (s in names(stocks)) {
  plot_stock(stocks[[s]], s, calculate_statistics(stocks[[s]], window)$ma)
}
```

Mean closing price by stock.

```{r bar, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
barplot(stats_table$Mean, names.arg = stats_table$Symbol,
        ylab = "Mean close price", col = "steelblue")
```
